title: NetherStarSword Mod
description: Mod that add one sword for 1.20.1
body:
# About Mod

A simple minecraft mod, that add only one thing. Star Sword that craft's using a Nether Star and a few other things

# About Sword
It's kinda OP weapon. But i don't know. It's better then Netherite sword at least
and it's kinda solid and have about 5k durability.

It have **1 special ability**!
If you hold it, it give's you a **speed 3** effect... And that's all
